method.bootstrap: createScenarioWorld survivors: natural landscape, supplies and admissible landing, traits, arrivals, raids, heatwaves, natural wildlife; full factory timed separately after one landscape generation
method.distance: Cardinal shortest steps on current land; connectivity equivalent to 8-neighbor paths with strict blocked diagonal corners. Resource access same component; mining exposed cardinal contacts only, conservative (diagonal mining also exists).
method.local: Euclidean radii around chosen landing, accessible component only; berry yield accounts for current maturity, before stochastic rounding.
method.timing: One measured creation per seed, ordered; full repeat equality outside timer. Five samples, no robust percentile claims. No simulation/UI/native load requested. Final short generator audit ran while a separate colony pilot was active; diagnostic timings, not an isolated performance benchmark.
method.density: Tree neighbor distance ≤sqrt(2) guarantees crown overlap at current radius .8–1.12; not projected screen coverage.
